about_the_game:
In Chapter II, Faust travels to Japan to face one of his most terrifying challenges yet — infiltrating the lair of infamous child murderer Tsutomu Miyazaki. Surrounded by chilling remnants of his crimes, Faust must gather the evidence needed to expose this twisted killer and bring him to justice.

But this chapter is about more than a single case. It delves deeper into the secretive organization “Nostra Edemas”, unveiling its methods of punishment, its grim sense of justice, and the new characters who embody its philosophy. Along the way, players will explore haunting new locations that expand the world’s dark atmosphere.

Prepare for an intense continuation of Faust’s journey — a story filled with shadows, revelations, and unforgettable moments.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of violence, cruelty and crime. There is also nudity in some scenes.
